location.travelNote: The brochure gives 18 minutes to Dubai International Airport and 8 to DIFC. The current official landing page instead gives 15 and 5 minutes. These source differences remain unresolved. Estimates require a current route check. An exact visitor entrance pin and road address remain unverified. Directions use the project name.

floorPlans.note: All 25 options preserve complete original sheets from the broker-hosted 29-page pack. The official Arada brochure also contains these designs. Apartment figures follow the visible header ranges. Stale embedded engineering text is excluded. Villa and penthouse figures describe the whole multi-level home and repeat across its drawings without addition. Villa 2’s key-plan insets repeat Villa 1 information, while its own header gives 6,781 sq ft. Visible metric component sums differ from printed whole-home totals by 0.01 sq m. Some suite ranges and bedroom descriptions also conflict across sources. Confirm the contracted layout and revision.

review.imagery: Root visually inspected all 43 native brochure candidates and seven observed website images. Selected 32 own-project concept renders. Duplicate crops, generic lifestyle people, textures and unassociated skyline imagery were excluded. Original masters and source notices are retained. No as-built status is inferred.
review.floorPlans: Root reviewed every complete selected sheet, all visible residence header panels and ten building floorplates. Physical pages 3–12 and 15–29 are delivered unchanged. The full 29-page Allsopp & Allsopp mirror remains explicitly attributed. Visible header ranges take precedence over hidden BIM strings. Whole-home areas, Villa 2 inset conflict and rounding discrepancies remain qualified.
review.location: Root read the complete original physical brochure spread 48 and all twelve travel estimates. The current official page airport and DIFC differences remain explicit. No kilometre distances, exact street or entrance coordinates were inferred.
review.provenance: Original official brochure, current official HTML, observed website images and broker plan PDF have ordinary public-GET receipts dated 7 November 2026 with exact URLs, bytes and SHA256. No enquiries or access-challenge bypass. Canonical text and protected identity are preserved.

unavailable: Exact entrance coordinates, a verified road address and live journey times remain unavailable. Airport/DIFC travel estimates and villa inset, metric rounding and suite-range conflicts require confirmation.
